history.body: Hi, we have a young child and our rental is getting a bit tight. Is the 3-bedroom layout practical for a small family?

Yes—the 900 sq. ft. Type A has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, with an open-plan living and dining area and no long internal corridor, making good use of the space for a small family. Are you looking for your own stay or investment?
For our own stay. The open-plan living and dining sounds useful. Is there an outdoor area where our child can play?

There’s an approximately 10-acre landscaped facilities deck on Level 9, offering outdoor green space for residents. I can’t confirm whether there’s dedicated play equipment. Would you like to come see the layout and facilities? Would weekdays or weekends suit you better?
